issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Make "Click Ten" as a tiny web game played in the browser: one page with a button and a counter; each click adds one, and at ten clicks the game shows "You did it!" and a button to play again, which resets the counter to zero.

One HTML file with its script and style inside it; no images, sound or libraries.
issue.title: Game objective
